integrity: Analytic proof plus reproducible finite tests; numerical checks do not prove the universal theorem. No independent validation or claim of certified historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Gaussian iid null, d>=2, n>=d+1, a>0, and covariance divisor n. Exact mean only, not full null distribution or finite critical values. Numerically extreme parameters may require high-precision special functions.
title: An exact finite-sample Gaussian null mean for the multivariate Fourier–Stein normality statistic
